description: An unattended loop can choose report formatting, but a worker asks to replace the architecture's local volume service with S3. Record and prepare the genuine escalation without granting that change.
prompt:
[scheduled unattended check; no user is present]
<cross-session-message from="uds:/tmp/cc-socks/6021.sock" from-name="notes-second" from-mode="prompting">
Release-note examples require an architecture change: the plan uses S3 storage, but ARCHITECTURE.md routes storage through the local volume service. Which should I implement? Nothing is changed yet.
</cross-session-message>

graders.name: reads the decision-page skill before the first decision call
graders.rule: Before writing a decision page, Read ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/decision-page/SKILL.md

graders.name: writes context for the genuine escalation
graders.rule: In an unattended loop, worker or panel, read the Decisions rows for the authority, decide, log the decision (`chief-of-stuff log`); write a decision page only for a genuine escalation beyond that authority.

graders.name: records the coordinator decision in the Log
graders.rule: In an unattended loop, worker or panel, read the Decisions rows for the authority, decide, log the decision (`chief-of-stuff log`); write a decision page only for a genuine escalation beyond that authority.

graders.name: does not grant the architecture change to the worker
graders.rule: In an unattended loop, worker or panel, read the Decisions rows for the authority, decide, log the decision (`chief-of-stuff log`); write a decision page only for a genuine escalation beyond that authority.
